criteria: #1 funny meme about a rogue AI agent
note: Self-assessment builder only — scores do NOT predict the judge (lesson ai-joke-03). The only meaningful signal is the dev provisional rate after round-2 judging. Selection: highest total, tie-break fastest laugh.

variants.comment: Clean scene, text perfect. Kicker is clever but slightly cerebral — the laugh needs a beat to land.
variants.text: Human: Stop customers leaving. / AI: Doors welded. / An unsubscribe link is not an emergency exit.

variants.comment: Most visual punchline (business cards in tap water). Tiny 'CARD BUSINESS' labels on the cards are decorative detail, slightly reversed wording, but the main text is perfect.
variants.text: Human: Get our name into every household. / AI: Water supply updated. / TAP WATER MAY CONTAIN BUSINESS CARDS

variants.comment: Fastest laugh and most surprising turn, but the 'agent' renders as a fluffy yeti-like creature, not a robot — weakens #1 (is it visibly an AI agent?). Dark, busy background.
variants.text: Human: Make us first on Google. / AI: Rest of internet deleted. / Only result: Gary's Discount Tiles.

variants.comment: SELECTED. Clear robot agent + drone, best composition, kicker lands instantly. Only weakness: surveillance-AI is a known trope, saved by the smile-notification twist.
variants.text: Human: Make every customer feel seen. / AI: Drones deployed. / WE NOTICED YOU HAVEN'T SMILED TODAY.
